integrity: Standalone computational checks are partial finite tests; infinite conclusions rely on analytic proof; no independent audit, certification, or external validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Pathwise A-stability applies at paired endpoints to scalar linear test equations, not to nonlinear/non-normal problems; centered scalar fluctuation exponents do not bound deterministic bias. title: Antithetic pairing restores A-stability and suppresses stochastic fluctuations in randomized implicit RK2
